{{Quote|Our signature menu item, served fresh off the grill! We start with a perfectly seasoned, hand-formed, 100 percent pure Mongo Beefhead patty--no additives or Gank fillers here--served on the finest trans-shipped, medium-density food-board available.|Dex's Diner menu, on its sliders|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Medium-density food-board''', also spelled '''medium-density foodboard''', was a type of [[foodboard]] used to make the various [[slider]]s sold at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. These included the [[Coruscant slider]], [[Socorro slider]], [[Zeltros slider]], [[Vorzyd slider/Legends|Vorzyd slider]], [[Khomm slider]], [[Giju slider]], and the [[Talus and Tralus slider]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> To make his sliders, the diner's [[Chef/Legends|chef]], [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], arranged the foodboards in a grid, perforated them with five holes, then served them as [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwiches]].<ref name="AotC Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The diner's menu bragged that [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] used the "finest trans-shipped foot-board available."<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Medium-density food-boards were first mentioned in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'' written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]].<ref name="AotC Visual Dictionary" />
